title: Bechet as clarinetist and his teeth trouble
summary: Bechet loved clarinet at home but feared it on jobs; the interviewer recalls his teeth, John Reed and the old-timers' high regard.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
